answer: The gatehouse is Chartered glove dyer skin log with glove dyers confirmation. Passing it takes 4-year training, 207 supervised dyeings, identification exam, guild dues, and every alias must pass alone. A hundred would-be clones face a hundred separate bills: 92 POA and 17 minutes each, 46368 POA and 8568 minutes in all. Judge it by the reef: open, checkable, and older than the reward. Judge it by the karst: real money, real time, gone before any payout. Judge it by the nadir: a file that outlives the farm. An honest agent passes once; a farm pays a hundred times and still fails.
